primary.summary: OI-price confirmation: classify each move by open-interest change - long price-up/OI-up and short price-down/OI-up (new leveraged capital commits, reflexive fuel), avoid or fade moves on OI contraction (terminal closing flow, no fuel).
primary.mechanism: Open-interest change identifies the marginal flow behind a price move: OI expansion means NEW positions are being opened (leveraged conviction entering), which both reflects committed capital and creates future forced-flow fuel in the move's direction, while OI contraction means positions are being CLOSED (covering or liquidation) - terminal flow with nothing behind it. The tradable object is the OI-state interaction, not price persistence per se: our own logged e04 result is direct evidence the OI term is load-bearing, since price-down events WITH OI collapse went flat (-15 to -33 bps, fuel spent) while the OI-intact event population continued -153 bps over the same 2022+ window. Honest data window is ~Dec-2021 onward (e01: OI breadth); the strategy is flat before it, and the sealed holdout window has full OI coverage.
primary.falsifier: If the OI-conditioned book has no positive net IS Sharpe at 1x costs on its honest 2021-12+ window, OR an OI-ablated control (same construction, OI term removed) matches it within noise - i.e., the OI term is not load-bearing - the family is dead and we do not ship a re-labeled price-continuation book.

backups.summary: Trade-size composition cross-section: use avg-trade-size (volume/trades) and trade-count dynamics to identify the marginal participant - fade retail-swarm names (exploding count, shrinking size), side with large-trade flow - over 1-4 week horizons.
backups.mechanism: The kline trades field makes participant mix observable: an explosion of trade count with shrinking average trade size marks a retail attention swarm (social-media-driven, price-insensitive, nets long at attention peaks), while rising average trade size marks large or informed flow. Retail-swarm names are systematically overpriced at the margin and underperform over the following 1-4 weeks; large-trade-flow names outperform - a WHO-is-trading mechanism, distinct from aggressor direction (taker-flow), volume-move confirmation (volume-price divergence), and all price-persistence families. Full 2020-01 kline coverage; horizon deliberately beyond the 1-9-candle range our e03 falsification covered.
backups.falsifier: If the composition-sorted long-short spread has no positive net IS Sharpe at 1x costs at any 1-4 week horizon, or its edge survives with the trade-size/count term replaced by plain volume (composition not load-bearing), the family is dead.
